sentences.text: Christopher Wesson Bosh -LRB- born March 24 , 1984 -RRB- is an American professional basketball player for the Miami Heat of the National Basketball Association -LRB- NBA -RRB- .	NBA	National Basketball Association	Miami Heat	Miami Heat	basketball	basketball	National Basketball Association	National Basketball Association

A high school `` Mr. Basketball '' in Texas , Bosh left college at Georgia Tech after one season with the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men 's basketball team to enter the 2003 NBA draft .	NBA	National Basketball Association	Georgia Tech	Georgia Institute of Technology	basketball	basketball	2003 NBA draft	2003 NBA draft

He was selected fourth overall by the Toronto Raptors in a draft class that included multiple future NBA superstars such as LeBron James , Dwyane Wade and Carmelo Anthony .	NBA	National Basketball Association	Toronto Raptors	Toronto Raptors	LeBron James	LeBron James	Dwyane Wade	Dwyane Wade	Carmelo Anthony	Carmelo Anthony	Toronto	Toronto

While at Toronto , Bosh emerged as one of the young stars in the league ; he became a five-time NBA All-Star , was named to the All-NBA Second Team once , appeared for the U.S. national team -LRB- with whom he won a gold medal at the 2008 Summer Olympics -RRB- , and supplanted former fan-favorite Vince Carter as the face and leader of the Raptors franchise .
